label: VERIFIED
extraction: Multi-agent repo framework comparison. AG2 (AutoGen 2): Python-based, frames everything as async conversation between specialized agents; supports multi-agent collaboration, tool integration, code execution; event-driven architecture allows concurrent work, reduces bottlenecks, supports human-in-the-loop. CrewAI: role-based orchestration with agents assigned roles (Researcher, Writer, Critic). LangChain & LangGraph: LangGraph represents agent reasoning as DAG for deterministic flows. OpenAI Agents SDK: official framework for function-calling and agent handoffs; emphasizes lightweight runtime and guardrails. Google ADK: agent development kit. Key concepts across frameworks: memory/context management (persistent state allows agents to reference previous steps or summarize long conversations), workflow orchestration (flows, DAGs, or event-driven architectures manage order of actions, error handling, retries).
